description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the intelligent face slimming feature (LiquifyFace)
description_zh: 本文介绍智能瘦脸LiquifyFace的语法及示例
name: LiquifyFace

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Image format requirements:

Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
Image size: No more than 6 MB.
Image resolution: At least 128 × 128 pixels and at most 5000 × 5000 pixels. The longest side must not exceed 5000 pixels.
Image content: Must contain at least 1 face and no more than 3 faces. Each face must be larger than 64 × 64 pixels.
The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
Image content: If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
图片格式要求：

图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
图像大小：不超过6 MB。
图像分辨率：大于等于128×128像素，小于等于5000×5000像素，最长边小于等于5000像素。
图像内容：至少包含1个人脸，最多不超过3个人脸，且人脸占比超过64x64像素。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
图像内容：当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The standard intensity. Valid values: [0, 2.0]. Default value: 1.0. A larger value produces a more noticeable face slimming effect
parameters.help_zh: 标准力度。取值范围为[0,2.0]，默认为1.0。数值越大，瘦脸效果越明显
parameters.name: slim_degree
